openwrt_wiki.einleitung: Five 1 gigabit/second Ethernet ports. Hardware versions v1, v2 and v3 use 3 external antennas for 5 GHz and 3 internal antennas for 2.4 GHz. Versions v4 and v5 use only 3 external dual-band antennas, for 2.4 GHz and 5 GHz. In these more recent versions, the 5 GHz chipset is integrated with the mainboard.
openwrt_wiki.installation_webui: For Archer C7 v1.1, v2, v2.1, v4, and v5 (fw1.0.11, fw1.2.0), installing OpenWrt is confirmed to work by simply uploading the OpenWrt firmware in the stock OEM's firmware-upgrade page. ... rename the file to firmware.bin before uploading.
openwrt_wiki.installation_alte_oem: For older stock firmware version for the Archer C7 v5, installing OpenWrt is only possible through TFTP server (v18.06.1 confirmed).
openwrt_wiki.installation_oem_1.0.11_20190726: router refuse install OpenWrt v21.02 from OEM's firmware-upgrade page or via TFTP, but it's possible to install OpenWrt v19.07.2 using the OEM UI, and from that do the upgrade to v21.02 using LuCI.
openwrt_wiki.installation_oem_1.2.0_1.1.4: accepted the openwrt-21.02.3 firmware image via upgrade page without issues
openwrt_wiki.installation_2026-03-30: Archer C7 v5.6 OEM fw 1.2.1 build 20220715 rel. 19099(5553) accepted openwrt-25.12.2-ath79-generic-tplink_archer-c7-v5-squashfs-factory.bin via upgrade page without issue
openwrt_wiki.tftp: PC 192.168.0.66/24, Router-Client 192.168.0.86, an gelbem LAN-Port; For Archer C7 v4 and v5, you must use the dedicated 'Reset' button near the power button.; Datei ArcherC7v5_tp_recovery.bin
openwrt_wiki.tftp_eu_hinweis: Archer c7 v5 (EU): WPS-LED leuchtet beim Suchen der Datei, ca. 7 s Download, Power-LED blinkt ca. 80 s waehrend des Flashens
openwrt_wiki.tftp_arp_problem: Some versions of the Archer C7v5 (US) firmware do not reply to ARP properly, and the tftp fails because of that. Workaround: arp -s 192.168.0.86 <bootloader MAC>
openwrt_wiki.flash_layout_v5_19.07.6: factory-uboot 0x0-0x20000, u-boot 0x20000-0x40000, partition-table 0x40000, art 0x50000, info 0x60000, user-config 0x80000-0xc0000, firmware 0xc0000-0xfc0000, default-config 0xff0000-0x1000000
openwrt_wiki.serial_v5.0: RX pin not connected to connector. Before soldering connector, connect RX wire to R27, like on the photo (ver: 5.0; archer_c7_v5_1..3.jpeg.jpg)
openwrt_wiki.serial_allgemein: Use 115200 baud 8N1 (v2.0); To enter the u-boot prompt, enter 'tpl' when 'Autobooting in 1 seconds' is displayed (v1.1)
openwrt_wiki.known_issue_5ghz: 5 GHz Wi-Fi not working as AP for C7 V2 and V5: 'ath10k_pci 0000:00:00.0: SWBA overrun on vdev 0, skipped old beacon' nach einigen Stunden, alle Clients fliegen raus; Bug openwrt/openwrt#6937, laut Seite noch in 23.05.0-rc2

openwrt_wiki_c5c7.serial_c7_v4_us: The first through hole is TX, second RX and third GROUND. There were two missing resistors at R27 and R24 ... (FYI: from TP-Link engineering, R24 = 220R, R27 = 1K). Use 115200, 8N1, no flow control.
openwrt_wiki_c5c7.serial_c7_v5_eu: As I didn't have 0402 sized resistors at home, I've used just one 0603 of 180R value. (Foto archer-c7-v5-eu-uart.jpg)

lauf.notiz: Erster Lauf. ToH-Dump (pid 15677765) und Live-hwdata, OpenWrt-Wiki Archer C7 und C5/C7/WDR7500 (Rohtexte aus Caches der Läufe C7 v2 / A7 v5 vom selben Tag), zwei Wiki-Fotos zur seriellen Konsole v5, OpenWrt-Commits ar71xx/ath79, DTS, Image-Makefile, Safeloader, Gluon-Target und Re-Add-PR #2436, Issue 6937, DeviWiki, WikiDevi, FCC TE7C7V5 (Grant, Multiple Listing, Label, Handbuch REV5.0.0, MPE, Innen-/Außenfotos aus dem A7-v5-Cache; RF-Bericht 2.4 GHz neu), TP-Link-Datenblatt C7(EU&US) 5.0, Downloadseite (Firmware bis 1.3.1 Build 260821 vom 2026-08-27), Produktseite, Gecid-Test. Innen, 12 V 1.5 A Hohlstecker, Netzteil beiliegend, 5x Gbit (1 WAN + 4 LAN), 1x USB 2.0, 3 feste Dualband-Dipole (3/5 dBi), 3x3 je Band, 128 MB RAM / 16 MB SPI-NOR (GigaDevice oder Winbond), kein PoE. Seriell: J1 4 Löcher ohne Stiftleiste, RX erst nach Bestücken von R24/R27. Offen: DC-Steckermaß, Leistungsaufnahme, Wandmontage-Details, neue Stock-Firmware 2026.
